_note: PRIVATE DRAFT. All numbers measured on 2026-09-13. Nothing here is invented; fields that could not be measured are explicitly null with a 'not_measured' reason.

tipsport_tennis_market_feed.caveat: The bookmaker does not publish a server-side timestamp on its own prices. The component from the bookmaker publishing a change to our first read of that change is therefore bounded (<= 5 s), not directly observed; the remainder of the chain is directly measured. Median/p95/worst-case above combine the bounded component with the measured ones.

tipsport_tennis_moneyline_openings.not_measured: This feed records an opening and a running latest price per match rather than a timed price tape, so a per-change delay was not measurable in this pass.

czech_multibook_price_tape.not_measured: Only the interval between recorded price points was measured; the publish-to-available delay for this tape was not instrumented.

goldbet_tennis_listing_feed.not_measured: This feed stores first-seen timestamps only; no publish-side reference timestamp exists, so a delay figure was not measurable.

inbet_tennis_listing_feed.not_measured: Same as above: first-seen timestamps only.
